messages:
eli: Heads-up — just saw a user report: Editor role cannot rotate API keys in Console after the 2026.03.20 deploy. They get a permission denied and we see KMS decrypt errors in the trace.

eli: stack snippet from console logs: `ERROR 403 KMS.Decrypt denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01 - context: {\"purpose\":\"api-key-unwrap\"}`

deploy-bot: release 2026.03.20-rc4 deployed to prod (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

tariq: omg. was there an RBAC refactor in this release?

kirsten: there was a roles merge for viewer+editor flags — we switched many checks to `role:editor_v2` and tightened KMS access to `kms:Decrypt` scoped by `requester:role`.

samir: can you paste the exact console path that fails? is this the API key rotate flow (`/projects/:id/keys/rotate`)?

eli: yes `/projects/42/keys/rotate`. Repro steps: login as a user with Editor role -> Console shows rotate button -> click -> spinner -> toast "permission denied" -> nothing in UI.

eli: minimal server log around the request:```
2026-03-20T14:02:57Z INFO request id=req_xxx user=alice role=editor_v2 path=/projects/42/keys/rotate
2026-03-20T14:02:57Z WARN crypto/kms decrypt failed err=AccessDenied
2026-03-20T14:02:57Z ERROR api/keys rotate failed status=403 detail="KMS decrypt denied for wrapping key"
```

tariq: hmm. the new policy conditions were supposed to allow editor_v2 but maybe the attribute key is `role_name` vs `role`. Did the token issuer change attribute name?

kirsten: I pulled the IAM policy used by the KMS role. The condition uses `StringEquals` on `redwood:role` and we recently renamed the claim to `redwood:role_name` in the auth proxy. So KMS is rejecting because condition doesn't match.

samir: that explains the KMS error but why did this only affect editors and not admins?

kirsten: admins are matched by a separate clause (`redwood:internal=true`) which still applies. Editors rely on the role claim condition.

eli: immediate mitigation options?

tariq: quick fix: update KMS key policy to accept either claim name OR roll back the auth proxy claim rename. Which is faster?

kirsten: fastest is to add an extra condition to KMS key policy to also allow `redwood:role_name` until we coordinate a proper rollout. I can craft the delta.

samir: +1 for policy patch. Also we need to surface this on the audit logs and run a query for any failed decrypts in the last 24h. We should treat as Sev-2 until confirmed limited impact.

eli: assigning: @kirsten to push KMS policy patch, @tariq to prepare rollback plan for auth-proxy rename, @samir to run audit queries and assemble impacted user list.

kirsten: drafting policy change now. patch preview:```
{
  "Sid": "AllowEditorsDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/console-kms-decryptor"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "ForAnyValue:StringEquals": {
      "redwood:role": ["editor_v2"],
      "redwood:role_name": ["editor_v2"]
    }
  }
}
```

kirsten: will push as emergency policy update and notify infra on the change window.

tariq: if we push policy patch, we should still do a quick rollback plan in case it exposes another gap. I'll stage a revert PR for the auth proxy rename and keep it ready.

samir: audit query done — found 18 failed decrypt attempts across 6 users in last 3 hours, all Editor-role accounts. No admin failures. I'm attaching the user list in the ticket I'm creating (SEC-453).

eli: good work. Once KMS patch is in, can someone confirm UI rotate flow for a repro Editor?

kirsten: patch applied to key `abcd-ef01` (managed) at 2026-03-20T14:40:03Z.

infra-bot: kms policy update recorded: change-id=chg_789 auth=kirsten at 2026-03-20T14:40:03Z

samir: re-ran the rotate flow as alice (editor). Success: 200 OK, toast "Key rotated". Audit shows `kms:Decrypt` success entries for the same requests.

eli: closing impact loop: editors affected — rotation flow restored. Need follow-ups: (1) reconcile claim name across auth-proxy + docs, (2) add unit/end-to-end test for role claim name in integration, (3) backfill an alert for KMS decrypt spikes.

tariq: I'll open the PRs for auth-proxy revert-or-adjust and the integration test.

kirsten: also recommend a short-lived rollback window policy: when claim-to-policy mappings change, we should include a dual-name condition for 48h by default. I'll add to the playbook.

samir: SEC-453 created with timeline + user list + mitigation steps. Marking Sev-2 -> Ready for review.

eli: thanks all. :thumbsup:
